    19	type PricePerItemProps = {
    20	    currency: string
    21	    basePrice?: number
    22	}
    23	
    24	const PricePerItem = ({currency, basePrice}: PricePerItemProps) => {
    25	    return (
    26	        <Text fontSize={{base: '12px', lg: '14px'}}>
    27	            <FormattedNumber style="currency" currency={currency} value={basePrice ?? 0} />
    28	            <FormattedMessage
    29	                defaultMessage="ea"
    30	                id="price_per_item.label.each"
    31	                description="Abbreviated 'each', follows price per item, like $10/ea"
    32	            />
    33	        </Text>
    34	    )
    35	}
    36	
    37	type ItemPriceProps = {
    38	    currency: string
    39	    align?: string
    40	    baseDirection?: string
    41	    [key: string]: unknown
    42	}
    43	
    44	/**
    45	 * In the context of a cart product item variant, this component renders the item's
    46	 * pricing, taking into account applied discounts as well as base item prices.
    47	 * When an item-level promotion reduces the price, the original price is shown
    48	 * crossed out beside the discounted current price.
    49	 */
    50	const ItemPrice = ({currency, align = 'right', baseDirection = 'column', ...props}: ItemPriceProps) => {
    51	    const variant = useItemVariant() as Record<string, unknown>
    52	    const price = variant?.price as number | undefined
    53	    const priceAfterItemDiscount = variant?.priceAfterItemDiscount as number | undefined
    54	    const priceAfterOrderDiscount = variant?.priceAfterOrderDiscount as number | undefined
    55	    const isASet = (variant?.type as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.set as boolean | undefined
    56	    const isMaster = (variant?.type as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.master as boolean | undefined
    57	    const quantity = ((variant?.quantity as number | undefined) ?? 1)
    58	
    59	    // Use the most-discounted price as the displayed current price: after all order-level
    60	    // adjustments if available, otherwise after item-level adjustments.
    61	    const effectiveCurrentPrice = priceAfterOrderDiscount ?? priceAfterItemDiscount ?? price ?? 0
    62	    const isOnSale = (price ?? 0) > effectiveCurrentPrice
    63	
    64	    let priceData
    65	    if (variant?.itemId) {
    66	        priceData = {
    67	            currentPrice: effectiveCurrentPrice,
    68	            // Show the original price crossed out when any promotion (item- or order-level) has
    69	            // reduced the price. The base SFCC component sets listPrice: null to suppress this.
    70	            listPrice: isOnSale ? price : null,
    71	            // Divide effectiveCurrentPrice (after all discounts) by quantity rather than using
    72	            // variant.pricePerUnit, which SFCC computes from the original list price and would
    73	            // show the wrong per-unit value when an order-level discount is applied.
    74	            pricePerUnit: quantity > 0 ? effectiveCurrentPrice / quantity : effectiveCurrentPrice,
    75	            isASet,
    76	            isMaster,
    77	            isRange: isASet || isMaster || false,
    78	            isOnSale
    79	        }
    80	    } else {

    82	    }
    83	    const isDesktop = useBreakpointValue({base: false, lg: true})
    84	    const intl = useIntl()
    85	
    86	    return (
    87	        <Stack
    88	            textAlign={align}
    89	            direction={baseDirection}
    90	            justifyContent={align === 'left' ? 'flex-start' : 'flex-end'}
    91	            alignItems="baseline"
    92	            spacing={priceData?.isOnSale ? 0 : 1}
    93	            wrap="nowrap"
    94	            {...props}
    95	        >
    96	            {!isDesktop && quantity > 1 && !isASet && priceData?.pricePerUnit && (
    97	                <PricePerItem currency={currency} basePrice={priceData.pricePerUnit} />
    98	            )}
    99	
   100	            {variant?.itemId && isOnSale ? (
   101	                // ZimmProductPrice already owns the Was/Now label treatment — reuse it rather
   102	                // than duplicating the label strings and styling. Prices are formatted here
   103	                // because ZimmProductPrice expects pre-formatted strings, not raw numbers.
   104	                <ZimmProductPrice
   105	                    currentPrice={intl.formatNumber(effectiveCurrentPrice, {style: 'currency', currency})}
   106	                    originalPrice={intl.formatNumber(price ?? 0, {style: 'currency', currency})}
   107	                    isLive={true}
   108	                />
   109	            ) : variant?.itemId ? (
   110	                <DisplayPrice
   111	                    labelForA11y={variant?.name as string}
   112	                    currency={currency}
   113	                    priceData={priceData}
   114	                    listPriceProps={{fontSize: 'sm'}}
   115	                />

   118	                    labelForA11y={variant?.name as string}
   119	                    currency={currency}
   120	                    priceData={priceData}
   121	                    quantity={variant?.quantity as number}
   122	                    listPriceProps={{fontSize: 'sm'}}
   123	                />
   124	            )}
   125	
   126	            {isDesktop && quantity > 1 && !isASet && priceData?.pricePerUnit && (
   127	                <PricePerItem currency={currency} basePrice={priceData.pricePerUnit} />
   128	            )}
   129	        </Stack>
   130	    )
   131	}
   132	
   133	export default ItemPrice

    31	import {useProducts} from '@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react'
    32	import type {ShopperBasketsTypes} from 'commerce-sdk-isomorphic'

    34	import {consolidateDuplicateBonusProducts} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/utils/bonus-product/cart'
    35	
    36	
    37	// Narrowed from ShopperBasketsTypes.PriceAdjustment: only the three fields this component reads.
    38	// appliedDiscount and discount-type logic are omitted by design — the display format is always
    39	// "{promotion_name} Applied" regardless of promotion type.
    40	type OrderPriceAdjustment = Pick<ShopperBasketsTypes.PriceAdjustment, 'priceAdjustmentId' | 'itemText' | 'price'>
    41	
    42	// BasketProp is kept as a local narrowed type because this component renders both baskets
    43	// (basketId) and orders (orderNo), and no single SDK type covers both response shapes.
    44	type BasketProp = {
    45	    basketId?: string
    46	    orderNo?: string
    47	    currency?: string
    48	    productSubTotal?: number
    49	    orderTotal?: number
    50	    productTotal?: number
    51	    shippingTotal?: number | null
    52	    taxTotal?: number | null
    53	    productItems?: ShopperBasketsTypes.ProductItem[]
    54	    orderPriceAdjustments?: OrderPriceAdjustment[]
    55	    shippingItems?: ShopperBasketsTypes.ShippingItem[]
    56	    couponItems?: ShopperBasketsTypes.CouponItem[]
    57	}
    58	
    59	type CartItemsProps = {
    60	    basket: BasketProp
    61	}
    62	
    63	const CartItems = ({basket}: CartItemsProps) => {
    64	    const totalItems = basket?.productItems?.reduce((acc: number, item: ShopperBasketsTypes.ProductItem) => acc + (item.quantity ?? 0), 0) || 0
    65	    const productIds = basket?.productItems?.map((item: ShopperBasketsTypes.ProductItem) => item.productId).join(',') ?? ''
    66	    const {data: products} = useProducts(
    67	        {
    68	            parameters: {
    69	                // SDK type expects string[] but the base component passes a comma-joined string — runtime behaviour is correct
    70	                ids: productIds as unknown as string[],
    71	                // allImages is still required (not just expand:['images']) so the image group for the
    72	                // cart item's actual selected variant is included, not just the default representative one.
    73	                allImages: true,
    74	                // Narrow expand from the full default set (prices, availability, promotions, options,
    75	                // set_products, recommendations, shipping_methods, page_meta_tags) to only what
    76	                // CartItemVariantImage/Name/Attributes/Price read from the product.
    77	                expand: ['images', 'variations'],
    78	                // Scoped to the fields those four components read, and the imageGroups filtered to the
    79	                // 'small' viewType CartItemVariantImage looks up — the smallest supported image
    80	                // expansion that still lets findImageGroupBy match the purchased variant's colour.
    81	                select: '(data.(id,name,master.(masterId),type.(bundle,master,set),c_isSale,variationAttributes.(id,name,values.(value,name)),imageGroups[viewType=small].(viewType,images.(link,disBaseLink,alt),variationAttributes.(id,values.(value)))))'
    82	            }
    83	        },
    84	        {
    85	            enabled: Boolean(productIds),
    86	            // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
    87	            select: (result: any) => {
    88	                // Index products by id for O(1) lookup when building variant objects below.
    89	                return result?.data?.reduce((acc: Record<string, unknown>, item: {id: string}) => {
    90	                    acc[item.id] = item
    91	                    return acc
    92	                }, {})
    93	            }
    94	        }
    95	    )
    96	
    97	    return (
    98	        <Accordion allowToggle={true} width="100%">
    99	            <AccordionItem style={{border: 0}}>
   100	                <AccordionButton color="blue.700">
   101	                    <BasketIcon aria-hidden={true} />
   102	                    <Box px={2}>
   103	                        <FormattedMessage
   104	                            id="order_summary.cart_items.action.num_of_items_in_cart"
   105	                            description="clicking it would expand/show the items in cart"
   106	                            defaultMessage="{itemCount, plural, =0 {0 items} one {# item} other {# items}} in cart"
   107	                            values={{itemCount: totalItems}}
   108	                        />
   109	                    </Box>
   110	                    <AccordionIcon />
   111	                </AccordionButton>
   112	                <AccordionPanel px={0} py={4}>
   113	                    <Stack spacing={5} align="flex-start" divider={<Divider />}>
   114	                        {(() => {
   115	                            const consolidatedItems = consolidateDuplicateBonusProducts(
   116	                                basket.productItems || []
   117	                            )
   118	                            return consolidatedItems.map((product: ShopperBasketsTypes.ProductItem, idx: number) => {
   119	                                const variant = {
   120	                                    ...product,
   121	                                    ...((products as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.[product.productId ?? ''] ?? {}),
   122	                                    price: product.price
   123	                                }
   124	                                return (
   125	                                    <ItemVariantProvider
   126	                                        key={`order-summary-item-${product.productId ?? ''}-${
   127	                                            product.itemId || idx
   128	                                        }`}
   129	                                        index={idx}
   130	                                        variant={variant}
   131	                                    >

   134	                                            <Stack width="full" spacing={1} marginTop="-3px">

   136	                                                <CartItemVariantAttributes includeQuantity />
   137	                                                <CartItemVariantPrice
   138	                                                    baseDirection="row"
   139	                                                    currency={basket?.currency}
   140	                                                />
   141	                                            </Stack>
   142	                                        </Flex>
   143	                                    </ItemVariantProvider>
   144	                                )
   145	                            })
   146	                        })()}
   147	
   148	                        <Button as={Link} to="/cart" variant="link" width="full" color="blue.700">
   149	                            <FormattedMessage
   150	                                defaultMessage="Edit cart"
   151	                                id="order_summary.cart_items.link.edit_cart"
   152	                            />
   153	                        </Button>
   154	                    </Stack>
   155	                </AccordionPanel>
   156	            </AccordionItem>

   161	type OrderSummaryProps = {
   162	    basket: BasketProp
   163	    showPromoCodeForm?: boolean
   164	    showCartItems?: boolean
   165	    isEstimate?: boolean
   166	    fontSize?: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl'
   167	}
   168	
   169	const OrderSummary = ({
   170	    basket,
   171	    showPromoCodeForm = false,
   172	    showCartItems = false,
   173	    isEstimate = false,
   174	    fontSize = 'md'
   175	}: OrderSummaryProps) => {
   176	    const {removePromoCode, ...promoCodeProps} = usePromoCode()
   177	
   178	    if (!basket?.basketId && !basket?.orderNo) {
   179	        return null
   180	    }
   181	    // Aggregate price adjustments across every shipment, not just the first — a multi-shipment
   182	    // basket can have shipping promotions on shipment 2+ that shippingItems[0] alone would miss.
   183	    const shippingPriceAdjustments =
   184	        basket.shippingItems?.flatMap((item) =>
   185	            (item.priceAdjustments ?? []).map((adjustment) => ({...adjustment, shipmentId: item.shipmentId}))
   186	        ) ?? []
   187	    const hasShippingPromos = shippingPriceAdjustments.length > 0
   188	
   189	    return (
   190	        <Stack data-testid="sf-order-summary" spacing={5}>
   191	            <Heading fontSize={fontSize} pt={1} id="order-summary-heading">
   192	                <FormattedMessage
   193	                    defaultMessage="Order Summary"
   194	                    id="order_summary.heading.order_summary"
   195	                />
   196	            </Heading>
   197	
   198	            <Stack
   199	                spacing={4}
   200	                align="flex-start"
   201	                role="region"
   202	                aria-labelledby="order-summary-heading"
   203	            >
   204	                {showCartItems && <CartItems basket={basket} />}
   205	
   206	                <Stack w="full">
   207	                    <Flex justify="space-between" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">
   208	                        <Text fontWeight="bold" fontSize={fontSize}>
   209	                            <FormattedMessage
   210	                                defaultMessage="Subtotal"
   211	                                id="order_summary.label.subtotal"
   212	                            />
   213	                        </Text>
   214	                        <Text fontWeight="bold" fontSize={fontSize}>
   215	                            <FormattedNumber
   216	                                style="currency"
   217	                                currency={basket?.currency}
   218	                                value={basket?.productSubTotal ?? 0}
   219	                            />
   220	                        </Text>
   221	                    </Flex>
   222	
   223	                    {/* Order-level promotions (e.g. VIC 20% member discount) are rendered as
   224	                        "{promotion_name} Applied" with the adjustment amount in green.

   226	                    {basket.orderPriceAdjustments?.map((adjustment: OrderPriceAdjustment) => (
   227	                        <Flex

   229	                            key={adjustment.priceAdjustmentId}
   230	                            aria-live="polite"
   231	                            aria-atomic="true"
   232	                        >
   233	                            <Text fontSize={fontSize}>
   234	                                {adjustment.itemText}{' '}
   235	                                <FormattedMessage
   236	                                    defaultMessage="Applied"
   237	                                    id="order_summary.label.promotion_applied_suffix"
   238	                                />
   239	                            </Text>
   240	                            <Text color="green.600" fontSize={fontSize}>
   241	                                <FormattedNumber
   242	                                    style="currency"
   243	                                    currency={basket?.currency}
   244	                                    value={adjustment.price ?? 0}
   245	                                />
   246	                            </Text>
   247	                        </Flex>
   248	                    ))}
   249	
   250	                    <Flex justify="space-between" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">
   251	                        <Flex alignItems="center">
   252	                            <Text lineHeight={1} fontSize={fontSize}>
   253	                                <FormattedMessage
   254	                                    defaultMessage="Shipping"
   255	                                    id="order_summary.label.shipping"
   256	                                />
   257	                                {hasShippingPromos && (
   258	                                    <Text as="span" ml={1}>
   259	                                        (
   260	                                        <FormattedMessage
   261	                                            defaultMessage="Promotion applied"
   262	                                            id="order_summary.label.promo_applied"
   263	                                        />
   264	                                        )
   265	                                    </Text>
   266	                                )}
   267	                            </Text>
   268	                            {hasShippingPromos && (
   269	                                <PromoPopover ml={1}>
   270	                                    <Stack>
   271	                                        {shippingPriceAdjustments.map((adjustment, index) => (
   272	                                            <Text
   273	                                                key={`${adjustment.shipmentId ?? 'shipment'}-${
   274	                                                    adjustment.priceAdjustmentId ?? index
   275	                                                }`}
   276	                                                fontSize="sm"
   277	                                            >
   278	                                                {adjustment.itemText}
   279	                                            </Text>
   280	                                        ))}
   281	                                    </Stack>
   282	                                </PromoPopover>
   283	                            )}
   284	                        </Flex>
   285	
   286	                        {basket.shippingTotal === 0 ? (
   287	                            <Text
   288	                                as="span"
   289	                                color="green.700"
   290	                                textTransform="uppercase"
   291	                                fontSize={fontSize}
   292	                            >
   293	                                <FormattedMessage
   294	                                    defaultMessage="Free"
   295	                                    id="order_summary.label.free"
   296	                                />
   297	                            </Text>
   298	                        ) : basket.shippingTotal != null ? (
   299	                            <Text fontSize={fontSize}>
   300	                                <FormattedNumber
   301	                                    value={basket.shippingTotal}
   302	                                    style="currency"
   303	                                    currency={basket.currency}
   304	                                />
   305	                            </Text>
   306	                        ) : (
   307	                            <Text fontSize={fontSize} color="gray.700">
   308	                                <FormattedMessage
   309	                                    defaultMessage="TBD"
   310	                                    id="order_summary.label.shipping_tbd"
   311	                                />
   312	                            </Text>
   313	                        )}
   314	                    </Flex>
   315	
   316	                    <Flex justify="space-between" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">
   317	                        <Text fontSize={fontSize}>
   318	                            <FormattedMessage defaultMessage="Tax" id="order_summary.label.tax" />
   319	                        </Text>
   320	                        {basket.taxTotal != null ? (
   321	                            <Text fontSize={fontSize}>
   322	                                <FormattedNumber
   323	                                    value={basket.taxTotal}
   324	                                    style="currency"
   325	                                    currency={basket.currency}
   326	                                />
   327	                            </Text>
   328	                        ) : (
   329	                            <Text fontSize={fontSize} color="gray.700">
   330	                                <FormattedMessage
   331	                                    defaultMessage="TBD"
   332	                                    id="order_summary.label.tax_tbd"
   333	                                />
   334	                            </Text>
   335	                        )}
   336	                    </Flex>
   337	                </Stack>
   338	
   339	                {showPromoCodeForm ? (
   340	                    <Box w="full">
   341	                        <PromoCode {...promoCodeProps} />
   342	                    </Box>
   343	                ) : (
   344	                    <Divider />
   345	                )}
   346	
   347	                <Stack spacing={4} w="full">
   348	                    <Flex w="full" justify="space-between" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">
   349	                        {isEstimate ? (
   350	                            <Text fontWeight="bold" fontSize={fontSize}>
   351	                                <FormattedMessage
   352	                                    defaultMessage="Estimated Total"
   353	                                    id="order_summary.label.estimated_total"
   354	                                />
   355	                            </Text>
   356	                        ) : (
   357	                            <Text fontWeight="bold" fontSize={fontSize}>
   358	                                <FormattedMessage
   359	                                    defaultMessage="Order Total"
   360	                                    id="order_summary.label.order_total"
   361	                                />
   362	                            </Text>
   363	                        )}
   364	                        <Text fontWeight="bold" fontSize={fontSize}>
   365	                            <FormattedNumber
   366	                                style="currency"
   367	                                currency={basket?.currency}
   368	                                value={basket?.orderTotal ?? basket?.productTotal ?? 0}
   369	                            />
   370	                        </Text>
   371	                    </Flex>
   372	
   373	                    {(basket.couponItems?.length ?? 0) > 0 && (
   374	                        <Stack

   376	                            border="1px solid"
   377	                            borderColor="gray.100"
   378	                            borderRadius="base"
   379	                            bg="white"

   381	                            <Text fontWeight="medium" fontSize={fontSize}>

   384	                                    id="order_summary.label.promotions_applied"

   386	                                :
   387	                            </Text>
   388	                            <Stack>
   389	                                {basket.couponItems!.map((item: ShopperBasketsTypes.CouponItem) => {
   390	                                    const couponItemId = item.couponItemId
   391	                                    return (
   392	                                    <Flex key={couponItemId} alignItems="center">

   405	                                                    id="order_summary.action.remove_promo"
   406	                                                />
   407	                                            </Button>
   408	                                        )}
   409	                                    </Flex>
   410	                                    )
   411	                                })}
   412	                            </Stack>
   413	                        </Stack>
   414	                    )}
   415	                </Stack>
   416	            </Stack>
   417	        </Stack>
   418	    )
   419	}
   420	
   421	export default OrderSummary

QUESTION: Does ANY requirement doc in this repo confirm the DISPLAY FORMAT for customer-group / promotion pricing in the cart and order summary? Specifically I need to know whether anything confirms:

(A) A basket-summary discount line format that is JUST "{promotion name} Applied" + amount, with NO discount PERCENTAGE. (A PR claims its flat, no-percentage format "matches the confirmed AC" — I need to find whether that confirmation exists in the repo at all.)

(C) An item-level / per-cart-line promotional label beneath a cart item (e.g. "20% off applied", "Private Sale — 20% Off Applied").
(D) Whether a Remove action should or should not appear on a basket-summary discount line.

SEARCH SCOPE — be exhaustive and report exactly what you searched:
1. `ls -R .docs/` (full tree listing, so I can quote the doc set).
2. Read any of these that exist, fully or the relevant sections: `.docs/prd/*.md` (especially anything named pricing, promotions, cart, checkout, customer-group, giftcards, regional, plp, pdp), `.docs/integration/*.md`, `.docs/memory/*.md` (projectState.md, sprintScope.md), `.docs/architecture.md`.
3. Grep widely, case-insensitive, across `.docs/`, `.claude/`, and repo-root `*.md`:
   - `grep -rn -i -E 'customer group|customer-group|price rule|catalogue price|catalog price|VIC|VIP|member discount|group discount' .docs .claude *.md`
   - `grep -rn -i -E 'was/now|was\b.*now|% off|percent off|off applied|promotion name|priceAdjustment|discount line|order summary' .docs .claude *.md`
   - `grep -rn -i -E 'SFCC-645|SFCC-778|SFCC-194|SFCC-38' . --include=*.md`
4. Also check `.claude/session-notes.md` and `.claude/registry/*.md` if they exist.
5. Check whether a Figma reference or Confluence link in the docs is cited as the source of truth for the cart discount line format.

Report:
(a) For each of A/B/C/D: does a confirmation exist? If yes, quote it with `file:line`. If no, say so plainly.
(b) The explicit list of directories/files/greps you ran, so I can state the search scope verbatim in a review finding.
(c) Note any doc that discusses promotions in cart at all, even if it doesn't settle the format — I want to know if the topic is simply absent vs. present-but-silent on format.

1	/*

     5	 * For full license text, see the LICENSE file in the repo root or https://opensource.org/licenses/BSD-3-Clause
     6	 */
     7	import React from 'react'
     8	import PropTypes from 'prop-types'
     9	import {FormattedMessage, FormattedNumber} from 'react-intl'
    10	import {
    11	    Stack,
    12	    Text,
    13	    useBreakpointValue
    14	} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/shared/ui'
    15	import {useItemVariant} from '.'
    16	import {getPriceData} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/utils/product-utils'
    17	import DisplayPrice from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/display-price'
    18	
    19	const PricePerItem = ({currency, basePrice}) => {
    20	    return (
    21	        <Text fontSize={{base: '12px', lg: '14px'}}>
    22	            <FormattedNumber style="currency" currency={currency} value={basePrice} />
    23	            <FormattedMessage
    24	                defaultMessage="ea"
    25	                id="price_per_item.label.each"
    26	                description="Abbreviated 'each', follows price per item, like $10/ea"
    27	            />
    28	        </Text>
    29	    )
    30	}
    31	
    32	PricePerItem.propTypes = {
    33	    currency: PropTypes.string.isRequired,
    34	    basePrice: PropTypes.number
    35	}
    36	
    37	/**
    38	 * In the context of a cart product item variant, this component renders the item's
    39	 * pricing, taking into account applied discounts as well as base item prices.
    40	 */
    41	const ItemPrice = ({currency, align = 'right', baseDirection = 'column', ...props}) => {
    42	    const variant = useItemVariant()
    43	    const {price, priceAfterItemDiscount} = variant
    44	    const isASet = variant?.type?.set
    45	    const isMaster = variant?.type?.master
    46	    let priceData
    47	    // When variant has basket pricing, we should prioritize these prices for displaying
    48	    // since they may have take promotion/discount into account
    49	    // NOTE: try NOT to re-calculate these values since basket-level discount is complicated
    50	    if (variant?.itemId) {
    51	        priceData = {
    52	            currentPrice: priceAfterItemDiscount,
    53	            // we don't want to show strikethrough price for cart since listPrice is not available via basket pricing
    54	            listPrice: null,
    55	            pricePerUnit: variant?.pricePerUnit,
    56	            isASet,
    57	            isMaster,
    58	            isRange: isASet || isMaster || false,
    59	            isOnSale: price > priceAfterItemDiscount
    60	        }
    61	    } else {
    62	        // for wishlist page we extract price info from variant/product obj
    63	        priceData = getPriceData(variant)
    64	    }
    65	    const isDesktop = useBreakpointValue({base: false, lg: true})
    66	
    67	    return (
    68	        <Stack
    69	            textAlign={align}
    70	            direction={baseDirection}
    71	            justifyContent={align === 'left' ? 'flex-start' : 'flex-end'}
    72	            alignItems="baseline"
    73	            spacing={priceData?.isOnSale ? 0 : 1}
    74	            wrap="nowrap"
    75	            {...props}
    76	        >
    77	            {!isDesktop && variant?.quantity > 1 && !isASet && priceData?.pricePerUnit && (
    78	                <PricePerItem currency={currency} basePrice={priceData.pricePerUnit} />
    79	            )}
    80	
    81	            {variant?.itemId ? (
    82	                <DisplayPrice
    83	                    labelForA11y={variant?.name}
    84	                    currency={currency}
    85	                    priceData={priceData}
    86	                    listPriceProps={{fontSize: 'sm'}}
    87	                />
    88	            ) : (
    89	                <DisplayPrice
    90	                    labelForA11y={variant?.name}
    91	                    currency={currency}
    92	                    priceData={priceData}
    93	                    quantity={variant?.quantity}
    94	                    listPriceProps={{fontSize: 'sm'}}
    95	                />
    96	            )}
    97	
    98	            {isDesktop && variant?.quantity > 1 && !isASet && priceData?.pricePerUnit && (
    99	                <PricePerItem currency={currency} basePrice={priceData.pricePerUnit} />
   100	            )}
   101	        </Stack>
   102	    )
   103	}
   104	
   105	ItemPrice.propTypes = {
   106	    currency: PropTypes.string.isRequired,
   107	    align: PropTypes.string,
   108	    baseDirection: PropTypes.string
   109	}
   110	
   111	export default ItemPrice

     7	import React from 'react'

    10	import {
    11	    Box,
    12	    Flex,

    15	    Text,

    25	import {PromoCode, usePromoCode} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/promo-code'
    26	import ItemVariantProvider from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/item-variant'
    27	import CartItemVariantImage from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/item-variant/item-image'
    28	import CartItemVariantName from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/item-variant/item-name'

    30	import CartItemVariantPrice from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/item-variant/item-price'
    31	import PromoPopover from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/promo-popover'
    32	import {useProducts} from '@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react'
    33	import {BasketIcon} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/icons'
    34	import {consolidateDuplicateBonusProducts} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/utils/bonus-product/cart'
    35	
    36	const CartItems = ({basket}) => {
    37	    const totalItems = basket?.productItems?.reduce((acc, item) => acc + item.quantity, 0) || 0
    38	    const productIds = basket?.productItems?.map(({productId}) => productId).join(',') ?? ''
    39	    const {data: products} = useProducts(
    40	        {
    41	            parameters: {
    42	                ids: productIds,
    43	                allImages: true
    44	            }
    45	        },
    46	        {
    47	            enabled: Boolean(productIds),
    48	            select: (result) => {
    49	                // Convert array into key/value object with key is the product id
    50	                return result?.data?.reduce((result, item) => {
    51	                    const key = item.id
    52	                    result[key] = item
    53	                    return result
    54	                }, {})
    55	            }
    56	        }
    57	    )
    58	
    59	    return (
    60	        <Accordion allowToggle={true} width="100%">
    61	            <AccordionItem style={{border: 0}}>
    62	                <AccordionButton color="blue.700">
    63	                    <BasketIcon aria-hidden={true} />
    64	                    <Box px={2}>
    65	                        <FormattedMessage
    66	                            id="order_summary.cart_items.action.num_of_items_in_cart"
    67	                            description="clicking it would expand/show the items in cart"
    68	                            defaultMessage="{itemCount, plural, =0 {0 items} one {# item} other {# items}} in cart"
    69	                            values={{itemCount: totalItems}}
    70	                        />
    71	                    </Box>
    72	                    <AccordionIcon />
    73	                </AccordionButton>
    74	                <AccordionPanel px={0} py={4}>
    75	                    <Stack spacing={5} align="flex-start" divider={<Divider />}>
    76	                        {(() => {
    77	                            const consolidatedItems = consolidateDuplicateBonusProducts(
    78	                                basket.productItems || []
    79	                            )
    80	                            return consolidatedItems.map((product, idx) => {
    81	                                const variant = {
    82	                                    ...product,
    83	                                    ...(products && products[product.productId]),
    84	                                    price: product.price
    85	                                }
    86	                                return (
    87	                                    <ItemVariantProvider
    88	                                        key={`order-summary-item-${product.productId}-${
    89	                                            product.itemId || idx
    90	                                        }`}
    91	                                        index={idx}
    92	                                        variant={variant}
    93	                                    >
    94	                                        <Flex width="full" alignItems="flex-start">
    95	                                            <CartItemVariantImage width="80px" mr={2} />
    96	                                            <Stack width="full" spacing={1} marginTop="-3px">
    97	                                                <CartItemVariantName />
    98	                                                <CartItemVariantAttributes includeQuantity />
    99	                                                <CartItemVariantPrice
   100	                                                    baseDirection="row"
   101	                                                    currency={basket?.currency}
   102	                                                />
   103	                                            </Stack>
   104	                                        </Flex>
   105	                                    </ItemVariantProvider>
   106	                                )
   107	                            })
   108	                        })()}
   109	
   110	                        <Button as={Link} to="/cart" variant="link" width="full" color="blue.700">
   111	                            <FormattedMessage
   112	                                defaultMessage="Edit cart"
   113	                                id="order_summary.cart_items.link.edit_cart"
   114	                            />
   115	                        </Button>
   116	                    </Stack>
   117	                </AccordionPanel>
   118	            </AccordionItem>
   119	        </Accordion>
   120	    )
   121	}
   122	
   123	CartItems.propTypes = {
   124	    basket: PropTypes.object
   125	}
   126	
   127	const OrderSummary = ({
   128	    basket,
   129	    showPromoCodeForm = false,
   130	    showCartItems = false,
   131	    isEstimate = false,
   132	    fontSize = 'md'
   133	}) => {
   134	    const {removePromoCode, ...promoCodeProps} = usePromoCode()
   135	
   136	    if (!basket?.basketId && !basket?.orderNo) {
   137	        return null
   138	    }
   139	    const shippingItem = basket.shippingItems?.[0]
   140	    const hasShippingPromos = shippingItem?.priceAdjustments?.length > 0
   141	
   142	    return (
   143	        <Stack data-testid="sf-order-summary" spacing={5}>
   144	            <Heading fontSize={fontSize} pt={1} id="order-summary-heading">
   145	                <FormattedMessage
   146	                    defaultMessage="Order Summary"
   147	                    id="order_summary.heading.order_summary"
   148	                />
   149	            </Heading>
   150	
   151	            <Stack
   152	                spacing={4}
   153	                align="flex-start"
   154	                role="region"
   155	                aria-labelledby="order-summary-heading"
   156	            >
   157	                {showCartItems && <CartItems basket={basket} />}
   158	
   159	                <Stack w="full">
   160	                    <Flex justify="space-between" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">
   161	                        <Text fontWeight="bold" fontSize={fontSize}>
   162	                            <FormattedMessage
   163	                                defaultMessage="Subtotal"
   164	                                id="order_summary.label.subtotal"
   165	                            />
   166	                        </Text>
   167	                        <Text fontWeight="bold" fontSize={fontSize}>
   168	                            <FormattedNumber
   169	                                style="currency"
   170	                                currency={basket?.currency}
   171	                                value={basket?.productSubTotal}
   172	                            />
   173	                        </Text>
   174	                    </Flex>

   178	                            justify="space-between"
   179	                            key={adjustment.priceAdjustmentId}
   180	                            aria-live="polite"
   181	                            aria-atomic="true"
   182	                        >
   183	                            <Text fontSize={fontSize}>{adjustment.itemText}</Text>
   184	                            <Text color="green.600" fontSize={fontSize}>
   185	                                <FormattedNumber
   186	                                    style="currency"
   187	                                    currency={basket?.currency}
   188	                                    value={adjustment.price}
   189	                                />
   190	                            </Text>
   191	                        </Flex>
   192	                    ))}
   193	
   194	                    <Flex justify="space-between" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">
   195	                        <Flex alignItems="center">
   196	                            <Text lineHeight={1} fontSize={fontSize}>
   197	                                <FormattedMessage

   199	                                    id="order_summary.label.shipping"

feat(sfcc-645/sfcc-778): cart and catalogue price rule, display Was/Now pricing in cart, order summary and PDP size selection
# Description

Delivers SFCC-645 (cart item Was/Now pricing and order-level promotion display in order summary) and SFCC-778 (catalogue price rule display — PDP Was/Now correctly scoped to the selected size).

**Cart Was/Now (SFCC-645).** The base SFCC `item-price` component renders a flat price with no awareness of order-level promotions (e.g. VIC 20% member discount applied server-side). This override reads `priceAfterOrderDiscount` first, then `priceAfterItemDiscount`, as the effective current price and delegates the Was/Now label rendering to `ZimmProductPrice` — the same atom already used on PLP and PDP — rather than duplicating the label strings and styling.

**Order summary promotion display (SFCC-645).** The base `order-summary` renders promotion adjustments with discount-type branching logic (percentage vs fixed-amount). This override simplifies that to a flat `{promotion_name} Applied` format with the adjustment amount shown in green — no type detection, matching the confirmed AC.

**PDP Was/Now on size selection (SFCC-194/SFCC-778).** Was/Now was silently suppressed after a shopper picked a size. Root cause: `product-view` stores the selected size in local React state (`localSizeValue`) and never writes it to the URL, so `urlPid` was always `undefined` after a size pick — `selectVariantScopedPriceData` received no pid, fell back to colour-only (range) pricing, and correctly suppressed Was/Now for a range. Fix: `onVariationChange` on the standalone `ProductView` captures the selected size into `selectedSizeSelection` (stored as a `{ colour, size }` pair so a stale size from the previous colour can never resolve on the same render that `urlColour` changes). `pricingVariantId` is then derived by matching colour+size against the master's `variants[]`, giving `selectVariantScopedPriceData` a real pid to narrow on.

# Linked

- Tickets: **SFCC-645** (cart item price and order summary promotion display), **SFCC-778** (catalogue price rule display), **SFCC-194** (PDP Was/Now)
- Design: Zimmermann_Designs Figma file — PDP/Cart/Order Summary price treatment

# Squad ownership

- [x] Squad A

# Types of Changes

- [x] **New feature** (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [x] **Bug fix** (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)

# Changes

- `components/item-variant/item-price.tsx` (new override) — reads `priceAfterOrderDiscount` then `priceAfterItemDiscount` as the effective price; delegates Was/Now rendering to `ZimmProductPrice`; falls back to `DisplayPrice` when no discount applies or no `itemId` is present (wishlist path)
- `components/order-summary/index.tsx` (new override, **Tier 2**) — simplified `OrderPriceAdjustment` type with `appliedDiscount` and discount-type branching removed; renders each order adjustment as `{promotion_name} Applied` with the amount in green via `FormattedMessage` (i18n-ready, key `order_summary.label.promotion_applied_suffix`)
- `pages/product-detail/index.tsx` — adds `selectedSizeSelection` state captured via `onVariationChange`; derives `pricingVariantId` from colour+size match against master `variants[]`; replaces `urlPid` with `pricingVariantId` in the `variantScopedPriceData` memo; uses `SFCC_COLOUR_ATTRIBUTE_ID`/`SFCC_SIZE_ATTRIBUTE_ID` constants in variant match (no magic strings)
- `components/item-variant/item-price.test.tsx` (new) — 7 unit tests covering all branching paths: order-level discount, item-level discount, order-level takes precedence, no discount, and no-itemId (wishlist) paths

# How to test

```bash
npm run env -- dev && npm start
```

**Cart Was/Now**
1. Log in as a VIC member (eligible for 20% order-level discount)
2. Add a sale-priced product to cart — e.g. `4673TS251GVSCP0P`
3. Navigate to `/cart` — the item price should show **Was A$X.XX / Now A$Y.YY**
4. Confirm the "Now" price reflects `priceAfterOrderDiscount`, not the base `price`

**Order summary promotion**
1. With the VIC discount applied, check the order summary panel
2. Confirm the promotion row reads **"{Promotion Name} Applied"** with the discount amount in green
3. Confirm no percentage/type label appears — flat format only

**PDP Was/Now on size selection**
1. Navigate to a sale product — e.g. `/product/4673TS251?color=GVSCP`
2. On colour-only selection: Was/Now should be suppressed (price range across sizes)
3. Select a size — Was/Now should now appear with the specific variant's list vs sale price
4. Switch colour — Was/Now should immediately revert to colour-only (suppressed) until a new size is picked

# Protection-tier check

> ⚠️ **Tier 2** — `components/order-summary/` (Shared Commerce Components, **Squad A — Squad B notified**). No Tier 1 file touched anywhere in this diff.

# Testing

- [x] `npx tsc --noEmit` — clean
- [x] `npm run test` (Vitest) — `item-price.test.tsx` 7/7 tests pass; `variantScopedPrice.test.ts` 10/10 tests pass (existing, unmodified)
- [x] Local CodeRabbit (`coderabbit review --light --base develop`) — 3 findings, all resolved: magic strings replaced with `SFCC_COLOUR_ATTRIBUTE_ID`/`SFCC_SIZE_ATTRIBUTE_ID`; stale-size race condition fixed by storing `{ colour, size }` pair and guarding in the memo rather than relying on a `useEffect` reset (which fires one render too late)
- [x] `npx tsc --noEmit` re-run post CodeRabbit fixes — clean

- **Promotion stacking rules:** product, order, and shipping promotion types stack with each other; within the same type, only the highest discount applies. Sale items are excluded from promotion set-ups — customer group discounts do not stack on sale-priced items (PRC-18, revised per DR)
- Auto-applied promotions (free shipping, customer group discounts) applied silently without code entry (PRC-30)
- **Free shipping threshold** evaluated on the post-discount cart total — a promotion discount can reduce an order below the free shipping threshold (PRC-31)
- **Retail Rewards applied after promotion calculation** (PRC-32)
- Promotions displayed at line-item and/or order level in: mini-bag, cart, checkout, and order history (PRC-27)
- Applied promotion info passed to NewStore via MuleSoft at order placement (PRC-28)
- Cart/Bag page shows active promotion details: banner confirming promotion applied and inline code entry with validation feedback (valid / invalid / expired / already redeemed) (PRC-29)

---

## 2. Catalogue Markdowns and Promotions in Order Payload (PRC-13)

*(Confirmed 2026-06-24 — signed off Emma, Rebecca)*

=== pricing-currency-globale.md customer group section ===

---

## 5. VIC & Customer Group Pricing (PRC-17 – PRC-19)

Customer-group-specific catalogue pricing — visible on PLP, PDP, mini-bag, cart, checkout, recommended tiles, wishlist (not cart-only discounts). Discounts do not apply to products already on sale or to gift cards.

| Customer group | Discount |
|---|---|
| Gold VIC | Permanent 10% off all non-sale products |
| Platinum VIC | Permanent discount — rate TBC (Zimmermann to confirm) |
| VIC early access | Flat 30% off before public sale goes live; removed before public sale |
| Advent customers | e.g. 50% off during Advent events |
| PR companies and investors | Configured discount |

- **Customer group discounts do NOT stack on sale items** (PRC-18, revised per DR): sale items are excluded from promotion set-ups. Example: a Gold VIC customer receives 10% off full-price items, but if they add a sale product to cart they get the sale price only — no extra 10% on top. The system must continue to support this exclusion.
- Configurable priority rules in SFCC Business Manager (e.g. Gold VIC 10% excludes gift cards and items already on sale) (PRC-19)

content.text:
I have complete ground truth. Here are the findings.

## Verdict

The diff delivers the **Was/Now half** of both tickets and **none of the label half**. Two ACs (SFCC-645 AC3, SFCC-778 AC4/AC5) explicitly require an item-level promotional label; nothing in the diff renders one. One AC (SFCC-645 AC5) explicitly requires a discount percentage; the diff renders no percentage, and the PR's stated justification for omitting it is factually wrong about the base component. Meanwhile 4 of the 5 behaviours the diff *does* add beyond baseline are required by no AC, and they are the only behaviours the new tests and stories cover.

---

## 1. AC-by-AC conformance

**SFCC-645 — Cart Price Rule Display**

| AC | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| 1 — VIC/PLP standard pricing | **Not touched** | No PLP/product-tile file in the 9-file diff |
| 2 — VIC/PDP standard pricing | **Touched, works against AC as written** | `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx:497-518` now makes PDP Was/Now appear on size selection. No customer-group gate exists in that path — `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/variantScopedPrice.ts` has zero auth/customer reference; `product-detail/index.tsx:230`'s `useCustomerId` is used only for wishlist mutations (`:585`, `:644`). Directly contradicts SFCC-778 AC3. **Cannot determine** which holds without knowing BM's server-side scoping |
| 3 — Was/Now **+ "X% off applied" label** | **Half satisfied** | Was/Now: `overrides/app/components/item-variant/item-price.tsx:100-108`. Label: **absent** (scope in §2) |
| 4 — Non-eligible → full price, no label | **Satisfied by construction** | `item-price.tsx:62` `isOnSale = (price ?? 0) > effectiveCurrentPrice` → falls to `DisplayPrice` at `:109-115`. "No label" holds trivially since no label was built |
| 5 — Summary line: name **+ percentage** + amount | **Half satisfied — percentage missing** | `overrides/app/components/order-summary/index.tsx:226-248` renders `{adjustment.itemText}` + `"Applied"` + amount. No percentage in any added production code (grep-verified) |
| 6 — No Remove on that line | **Satisfied, but inherited** | `order-summary/index.tsx:226-248` has none — and neither did base `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/order-summary/index.jsx:176-192`. The PR adds nothing here |
| 7 — Carried to checkout | **Satisfied mechanically, untested** | `overrides/app/pages/checkout/` holds only `partials/payment.tsx` + `partials/normalizeStateCode.ts` at this revision — no checkout override. Base `checkout/index.jsx` imports `components/order-summary`, and `checkout/partials/shipping-product-cards.jsx` imports `item-variant/item-price`; ccExtensibility redirects both to these overrides in the real app build. No test or story covers checkout |
| 8 — Already-on-sale → no extra discount | **Not addressed** | No sale-exclusion logic anywhere. `item-price.tsx:61` renders whatever the basket returns. PRC-18 (`.docs/prd/promotions.md:20`, `.docs/prd/pricing-currency-globale.md:71`) puts no-stacking on BM, so arguably correct — but nothing here satisfies or tests it |
| 9 — Gift card | **Not touched** | No gift-card branch in the diff. Jersey 2026-09-16 confirms untestable anyway |
| 10 — Guest standard pricing | **No client-side guard** | Both `item-price.tsx` and the PDP path are unconditional on auth. Entirely server-dependent |

**SFCC-778 — Catalogue Price Rule Display**

| AC | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| 1 — Guest standard pricing | **No client-side guard** | As 645 AC10 |
| 2 — PLP Was/Now on the card | **Not satisfied, not touched** | No PLP/product-tile file in the diff |
| 3 — PDP Was/Now | **Satisfied** | `product-detail/index.tsx:483-518` — the substantive fix. Contradicts 645 AC2; Hazel questioned both on 2026-09-22 |
| 4 — Cart Was/Now **+ promotional label** | **Likely fails on both halves** | Label absent. Was/Now fires only when the basket returns `price > priceAfter*Discount` (`item-price.tsx:61-62`) — i.e. *adjustment*-driven. A catalogue price rule changes the product's own price via price book, so the basket line `price` **is** the reduced price, no "was" exists in the response, `isOnSale` is false, no Was/Now. Confidence medium — mechanism is clear from code, BM implementation is not |
| 5 — Checkout Was/Now + label | **Half, same caveats** | Was/Now reaches checkout by shadowing; label absent |
| 6 — Already-on-sale | **Not addressed** | As 645 AC8 |
| 7 — Gift card | **Not touched** | — |

**SFCC-194 — PDP Was/Now (already In SIT)**

| AC | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| 1 — Was/Now on active sale | **Satisfied / repaired** | `product-detail/index.tsx:497-518` fixes the size-selected case Jersey reported broken 2026-09-17 |
| 2 — No sale → standard only | **Satisfied** | `variantScopedPrice.ts:92-95,119-122` return null; `pricingVariantId` falls back to `urlPid` → colour-range → suppressed |
| 3 — Correct currency per storefront | **Not touched** | Delegated to `intl`/`FormattedNumber` |
| 4 — Expired sale drops Was/Now | **Not touched, no regression risk** | `selectedSizeSelection` (`:325`) stores only colour/size/productId — no price cached |

---

## 2. The item-level label — definitively absent

**No item-level promotional label exists in repo-owned code at `1a32bc94`.** Search scope, stated explicitly: `git ls-tree` of `overrides/app/components/item-variant/` (2 files only), `overrides/app/components/product-item/` (**does not exist**), `overrides/app/pages/cart/` (**does not exist**), `overrides/app/components/` (18 dirs, no cart/product-item), and the full `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/` inventory (no `zimmSaleBadge`/`zimmDiscount*`/`zimmPromo*`); full reads of `item-price.tsx`, `order-summary/index.tsx`, `ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductPrice/index.tsx`, `ui-kits/atoms/zimmBadge/index.tsx`, `ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductBadges/index.tsx`; and `git grep` at that revision for `priceAdjustment|itemText|promotion|promo|discount|% off|off applied|appliedDiscount`, `badge|callout|pill|tag`, `style='percent'`, and `\.(itemText|calloutMsg|promotionName|appliedDiscount|promotionId)` across `overrides/`.

Results:

1. `item-price.tsx:104-108` renders `ZimmProductPrice` with `currentPrice`/`originalPrice` only. `ZimmProductPrice` itself (`overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductPrice/index.tsx:22-28`, `:143-158`) has exactly two message constants — `Was {price}` / `Now {price}` — no percentage, no promotion name, no badge. The word "promotion" appears in `item-price.tsx` only in comments (`:47`, `:59`, `:68`, `:71-73`).
2. Only **2** hits for item-text rendering across all of `overrides/`, both order/shipping-level: `order-summary/index.tsx:234` and `:278`.
3. **The adjacent element does carry a signal, and it is not the AC's.** Because `overrides/app/components/product-item/` does not exist at this revision, cart rows render from base `product-item/index.jsx:68`, which mounts `CartItemVariantAttributes` → `node_modules/.../item-variant/item-attributes.jsx:196-224`: the fixed word `Promotions` + summed adjustment amount in green, with `calloutMsg` only inside a hover popover. The override itself mounts the same base component at `order-summary/index.tsx:136`. That is upstream code, not this PR, and it is neither the promotion name nor a percentage nor visible-beneath copy.
4. The real `"20% off applied"` label **does** exist — on the working tree's `feature/SFCC-11_cart` branch as `product-item/index.tsx:81-86` and `index.stories.tsx:232`, tagged SFCC-795. `git grep discountLabel 1a32bc94` returns **nothing**. So two branches are independently claiming this AC territory, and PR #118's ACs 3/4/5 depend on a component being built elsewhere.

---

## 3. The percentage claim — no confirmation exists in the repo

**No doc anywhere in this repo confirms a flat, no-percentage format.** Search scope: full `ls -R .docs/` (the complete confirmed doc set — `prd/` × 17, `integration/` × 19, `memory/`, `planning/`, `temp/`, `vendor/`), plus `.claude/` (`rules/`, `registry/`, `session-notes.md`), plus repo-root `*.md`; full reads of `.docs/prd/cart.md`, `promotions.md`, `pricing-currency-globale.md`; targeted reads of `checkout.md` §5/§11-12, `giftcards.md`, `orderManagement.md`, `architecture.md`, `memory/sprintScope.md`; and 15 case-insensitive greps including `customer group|price rule|VIC|member discount|group discount`, `was/now|% off|off applied|promotion name|discount line|order summary`, and `SFCC-645|SFCC-778|SFCC-194|SFCC-38` (**zero matches** — none of these tickets is mentioned in any markdown file in the repo).

5. **`order-summary/index.tsx:226-248` + PR description — the "confirmed AC" claim is unsupported, and its stated rationale is false.** The PR says: *"The base `order-summary` renders promotion adjustments with discount-type branching logic (percentage vs fixed-amount). This override simplifies that to a flat `{promotion_name} Applied` format… matching the confirmed AC."* Base `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/order-summary/index.jsx:183` is a single line — `<Text fontSize={fontSize}>{adjustment.itemText}</Text>` — with **no branching of any kind**. There is nothing to simplify. The override's entire functional delta on this AC-critical line is appending the literal word `"Applied"`; base already rendered name + amount at `:176-192`. Confidence: high. **In-scope defect.**
6. Every worked discount-label example in the repo carries a percentage. `.docs/prd/checkout.md:211` (PAY-028, signed-off sheet): *"Displayed as a separate named line item in the order summary (e.g. \"DISCOUNT | GOLD VIP - 10% OFF\"), showing the amount deducted from subtotal."* Carry the caveat: that sits in §12 Retail Rewards, and `checkout.md:215` (PAY-032) says Retail Rewards are a voucher, not a discount — so it's house precedent for wording a named summary deduction, not a direct AC. The only percentage-bearing label of record is `.claude/session-notes.md:393-395` (SFCC-795, item-level, `"20% off applied"`).
7. **A confirmed PRD contradicts the diff's whole mechanism.** `.docs/prd/pricing-currency-globale.md:63`: *"Customer-group-specific catalogue pricing — visible on PLP, PDP, mini-bag, cart, checkout, recommended tiles, wishlist (not cart-only discounts)."* The diff implements customer-group pricing as an **order-level cart adjustment** (`item-price.tsx:54,61` reads `priceAfterOrderDiscount`; `order-summary/index.tsx:226` reads `orderPriceAdjustments`) — i.e. exactly the cart-only discount the PRD excludes. SFCC-645 AC5 requires the summary line the PRD's model wouldn't produce. Per AGENTS.md **Doc integrity**, this is a pause-and-ask, not a silent pick. Confidence high on the conflict; which side is right is a product call. The nearest applicable requirement is `.docs/prd/promotions.md:24` (PRC-27): *"Promotions displayed at line-item and/or order level in: mini-bag, cart, checkout, and order history"* — "and/or" leaves the choice open and specifies no format. `.docs/prd/cart.md:25` (CAI-009) lists order-summary contents as *"item count, subtotal…, shipping…, tax…, grand total"* — **no discount line**.

---

## 4. Scope creep

Base-vs-override comparison against `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/order-summary/index.jsx`:

8. **Shipping "TBD" — `order-summary/index.tsx:306-313`. NEW, no AC requires it.** Base `:237-245` renders `FormattedNumber` unconditionally. Added in `1633ec91` for CodeRabbit. Confidence high. *Belongs to another ticket* — reasonable hardening, wrong PR.
9. **Tax "TBD" — `order-summary/index.tsx:320-335`. NOT new — inherited verbatim from base `:252-267`.** No AC, but also no change. Worth noting because CodeRabbit's auto-summary on the PR lists *"Improved handling of unavailable tax"* as a bug fix; it isn't one. Confidence high.
10. **Multi-shipment aggregation — `order-summary/index.tsx:183-187`, popover `:271-280`. NEW, no AC requires it.** Base `:139-140` reads `shippingItems?.[0]`. Added in `1633ec91` for CodeRabbit. Confidence high. *Another ticket.*
11. **`select:`/`expand:` narrowing — `order-summary/index.tsx:66-95`, esp. `:77-81`. NEW, no AC requires it, and it carries real risk.** Base `:41-44` passes `ids` + `allImages` only. This narrows a **shared** component's data fetch — `order-summary` is consumed by base `pages/cart/index.jsx`, `pages/checkout/index.jsx`, `pages/checkout-one-click/index.jsx`, and `pages/account/order-detail.jsx`. Any field a consumer reads that isn't in the hand-written `select:` string silently renders empty, including in `CartItemVariantAttributes` which the override itself mounts at `:136`. `c_isSale` is in the select string but nothing in the diff reads it. Added in `18bcfa30` for CodeRabbit. Confidence high that it's out of scope; medium on whether it actually breaks a consumer — **I could not determine that from code alone**, it needs a runtime check across all four pages. *In-scope concern for this PR*, since the PR introduced it.
12. **Coupon `Remove` guard — `order-summary/index.tsx:396`. NEW, no AC.** Base `:326` has no `couponItemId` check. Added in `1a32bc94` for CodeRabbit. Explicitly **not** SFCC-645 AC6 — that AC is about the `orderPriceAdjustments` line (`:226-248`), this is the shopper-entered `couponItems` block. Defensive only. Confidence high.
13. **The override's existence is disproportionate to its AC delta.** 421 new lines at Tier 2 (`protectedFiles.md` — Shared Commerce Components) to add one word to a line base already rendered, plus five non-AC changes. Confidence high. Worth a scope conversation, not necessarily a block.
14. **Test and story coverage is inverted — it covers only the scope creep.** `order-summary/index.test.tsx` has 7 tests (`:100,120,133,155,162,170,177`) covering shipping-promo aggregation and `shippingTotal`/TBD. All 4 stories (`:70` Default, `:81` ShippingPromotionOnLaterShipment, `:99` FreeShipping, `:109` ShippingTotalUnavailable) are baseline or the same two additions; `baseBasket` (`:60-67`) contains no `orderPriceAdjustments` and no `couponItems`. The test file never references `orderPriceAdjustments`, `Applied`, `Remove`, `couponItems`, or a percentage. **Zero coverage of the AC-required discount line** — the one thing the ticket asked for. `item-price.test.tsx` (8 tests, `:79-184`) does cover its Was/Now branching properly. Confidence high. **In-scope defect.**
15. **Registry churn is tooling-mandated, not scope creep** — `scripts/hooks/pre-commit:45-58` regenerates `.claude/registry/` on every commit touching `overrides/`. Note as housekeeping only: the `Last updated` stamp moves *backwards* (`2026-09-21T04:38:41Z` → `2026-09-21T00:46:03Z`) and consumer counts swing implausibly (Link 33→84, Image 8→50, Field 32→60), suggesting generation from a different tree state. Not an AC matter.

---

## 5. Guest PLP/PDP behaviour

16. **PDP behaviour changes for guests, identically to logged-in shoppers; PLP is untouched.** Trace: `product-detail/index.tsx:1330` passes `onVariationChange={handleVariationChange}` → `:483-491` stores `{colour, size, productId}` → `:497-511` derives `pricingVariantId` → `:513-518` feeds `selectVariantScopedPriceData`. Nothing on that path reads auth state: `variantScopedPrice.ts` contains no customer/auth reference and is purely `tieredPrices`-driven (`:92`, `:122-123`); `product-detail/index.tsx:230`'s `useCustomerId` is consumed only by wishlist mutations at `:585` and `:644`. So a guest who selects a size now sees Was/Now wherever the product response carries `tieredPrices`. Under SFCC-194 AC1 that is correct and desired. Under SFCC-645 AC10 / SFCC-778 AC1 it is safe **only** because SFCC scopes promotional pricing server-side per customer group — there is no client-side defence, so a BM misconfiguration surfaces group pricing to guests with nothing in this diff to stop it. **Cannot be determined from code alone.** Confidence high on the trace, none on the BM config.

---

## 6. Per-storefront scoping

17. **There is no per-site scoping anywhere in the diff's production code.** Verified: `item-price.tsx` and `order-summary/index.tsx` contain zero matches for `siteId|useMultiSite|multiSite|locale|storefront|site`. The only site references in the whole diff are test/story harness wrappers hardcoding `ZimmermannAU`/`en-AU` (`order-summary/index.stories.tsx:30-40`; `index.test.tsx:66`, `:564`). AGENTS.md **Multi-site & Routing** requires never assuming a storefront's behaviour without checking `.docs/prd/regional.md`; the PR cites no regional doc and its "How to test" section is AU-only.

Does it *need* site scoping? Arguably not for display — promotion assignment is per-site in BM and the SDK is initialised per `siteId`, so the basket response arrives already site-scoped. But these components render whatever the basket returns with no site awareness, and that is precisely the verification Hazel asked FED for on 2026-09-21 23:36 — *"FED - need to check that we are only applying the promotions on specific storefront as configured in BM"* — which landed **after** `1a32bc94`'s last commit. So: **not a defect in this diff, but an explicitly-requested check the diff does not perform and cannot be shown to satisfy.** Classify as a required follow-up on SFCC-778 before it can close. Confidence high.

---

## In-scope defects for this PR

- Item-level label absent (645 AC3, 778 AC4/AC5) — findings 1-4
- Percentage absent from summary line, with a false rationale in the PR body (645 AC5) — finding 5
- Order-level implementation conflicts with `pricing-currency-globale.md:63`; needs a doc-integrity pause — finding 7
- `select:` narrowing of a four-consumer shared fetch, no AC behind it — finding 11
- Tests/stories cover only the non-AC additions, nothing AC-required — finding 14
- PLP entirely unaddressed (778 AC2) — finding, table row

## Real but belongs to another ticket or person

- Shipping TBD, multi-shipment aggregation, coupon guard (findings 8, 10, 12) — CodeRabbit-driven hardening; should be their own ticket
- `"20% off applied"` item label — SFCC-795 on `feature/SFCC-11_cart`, already in progress (finding 4). Two branches claiming one AC needs deconflicting
- PDP fix is a defect repair on SFCC-194, already In SIT, landing in a PR titled for 645/778
- 645 AC8 / 778 AC6 no-stacking — BM responsibility per PRC-18
- 645 AC9 / 778 AC7 gift cards — untestable per Jersey 2026-09-16
- Per-storefront scoping — Hazel's post-commit request (finding 17)

## Could not determine from code alone

- Whether 778 AC4's cart Was/Now works at all, since it depends on whether BM implements the catalogue price rule as a promotion adjustment or a sale price book (only the former triggers `isOnSale` at `item-price.tsx:62`)
- Whether server-side customer-group scoping actually protects guests (645 AC10, 778 AC1)
- Whether the `select:` narrowing breaks any of the four base consumers — needs a runtime check
- Whether SFCC-645 AC2 or SFCC-778 AC3 is the intended PDP behaviour; they contradict each other as written and Hazel flagged this on 2026-09-22
- Currency/formatting per storefront (194 AC3) — needs a multi-site render
